settings.primary_tail: native chi-square 1, exploratory until real-count null and full-family checks
settings.fit_reuse: worker-local exact int64 tensor/shape LRU512, no approximation or hypothesis removal
settings.reporting_ablation: equal-primer pooled marker inclusion difference, same original count/subject set, no pseudocount; fixed tests/ranks/LR family and split direction checks

recipe.selection: one event and context per gene/cohort by frozen hash, up to16 genes per original subject-count/gene-coverage-quartile stratum in each cohort; all selected markerless and failed trials retained
recipe.law: fixed subject/primer baseline pooled across cell types, original per-type depths, fresh binomials and independent mean-zero shared-primer normal slopes; arbitrary baselines stress random-intercept misspecification, not that model own-law null or RNA PSI

scope: all frozen real-depth pattern stress trials; repeated draws and shared design parents do not certify extreme tails or whole-gene FDR; failures retained atp1
